description: One event's daily closing get-in on XP: the lowest all-in asking price per ticket in dollars, one point per day, oldest first, over 1 to 90 days (default 30) -- 'are prices going up?', 'should I wait for a price drop?'. This is the asking side over time; what tickets sold for is in get_recent_sales. History is recorded only for events someone is tracking, so an empty result is common and means no record, not a flat price. event_id comes from search_events or search_market.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.

name: get_price_history
title: Price History
